move.pan_left: the camera panned (rotated in place) {deg} degrees to the left
move.pan_right: the camera panned (rotated in place) {deg} degrees to the right
move.tilt_up: the camera tilted (rotated in place) {deg} degrees upward
move.tilt_down: the camera tilted (rotated in place) {deg} degrees downward
move.forward: the camera moved straight forward along its viewing direction
move.backward: the camera moved straight backward along its viewing direction
move.strafe: the camera moved sideways {direction} without turning
move.arc_left: the camera moved forward along a smooth curve while turning {deg} degrees to the left
move.arc_right: the camera moved forward along a smooth curve while turning {deg} degrees to the right
move.arc_up: the camera moved forward along a smooth curve while tilting {deg} degrees upward
move.arc_down: the camera moved forward along a smooth curve while tilting {deg} degrees downward
move.follow: the camera moved {direction} while following the subject, which moved {direction} by the same distance, so the subject keeps its size and place on screen and the surroundings shift around it
move.orbit_left: the camera orbited {deg} degrees around the subject, which stays at the same place on screen: the camera travelled to its own right around the subject while turning left to keep facing it, so the background behind the subject shifts
move.orbit_right: the camera orbited {deg} degrees around the subject, which stays at the same place on screen: the camera travelled to its own left around the subject while turning right to keep facing it, so the background behind the subject shifts
move.orbit_up: the camera orbited {deg} degrees vertically around the subject, which stays at the same place on screen: the camera moved down around the subject while tilting up to keep facing it
move.orbit_down: the camera orbited {deg} degrees vertically around the subject, which stays at the same place on screen: the camera moved up around the subject while tilting down to keep facing it
move.moving_pivot_prefix: the subject moved forward and the camera followed it; at the same time

editable_desc.reveal_left: the part of the scene that has just come into view on the left side, plus a thin band at its border
editable_desc.reveal_right: the part of the scene that has just come into view on the right side, plus a thin band at its border
editable_desc.reveal_top: the part of the scene that has just come into view at the top, plus a thin band at its border
editable_desc.reveal_bottom: the part of the scene that has just come into view at the bottom, plus a thin band at its border
editable_desc.forward: areas that were hidden or out of view before the forward move, plus a thin band around them
editable_desc.move: areas that were hidden behind nearer objects or out of view before the move, plus a thin band around them
editable_desc.follow: background that was hidden behind the subject or not visible before the move, plus a thin band around those areas
editable_desc.orbit: background that was hidden behind the subject or has just come into view after the orbit, plus a thin band around those areas

subject_rule.tp_subject: The subject, {name}, is already correct in the picture: preserve its appearance exactly, with the same size and screen position.
subject_rule.fp_ego: The hands at the bottom and anything they hold or push belong to the viewer and move with the camera: keep them exactly as they are.
subject_rule.none: Nothing in the visible part changes.

feedback_suffix: Correct this problem of the previous fill: {text}.

seam_feedback.seam_luma_step: the filled area is brighter or darker than the real pixels at its border; match their exposure and colour exactly
seam_feedback.seam_sharpness_ratio: the filled area is sharper or softer than the real pixels at its border; match their sharpness and grain
